model.jaffle_shop.fct_orders.name: fct_orders
model.jaffle_shop.fct_orders.raw_code:
select
    o.order_id,
    o.customer_id,
    o.order_date,
    o.status,
    o.order_amount,
    c.first_name,
    c.last_name,
    c.email
from {{ ref('stg_orders') }} o
left join {{ ref('stg_customers') }} c
    on o.customer_id = c.customer_id
model.jaffle_shop.fct_orders.compiled_code:
select
    o.order_id,
    o.customer_id,
    o.order_date,
    o.status,
    o.order_amount,
    c.first_name,
    c.last_name,
    c.email
from jaffle_shop.staging.stg_orders o
left join jaffle_shop.staging.stg_customers c
    on o.customer_id = c.customer_id

model.jaffle_shop.revenue_summary.name: revenue_summary
model.jaffle_shop.revenue_summary.raw_code:
select
    o.order_date,
    count(o.order_id) as order_count,
    sum(o.order_amount) as total_revenue,
    p.payment_method
from {{ ref('fct_orders') }} o
left join {{ ref('stg_payments') }} p
    on o.order_id = p.order_id
group by 1, 4
